d:
Okay. The moment has arrived. After four years of stories and continuations, here is the conclusion of the most famous annual series I've ever done, "Evil Convent (Mysterious Convent)."

It's been a long journey: four years, five parts. It started as a simple story, but seeing how much people liked it, the story kept growing until it became a full-fledged annual series. Every summer, a new chapter was released, divided into two parts (A and B), like the front and back of an old-fashioned record. It was fun, and I really enjoyed making it, from chapter one onward. But like everything in life, it has an end, and this is it... I hope you enjoy it and like it as much as I do.
